prompt_text:
P10 v28 — explicit price-approval request

Negotiate case:P10 only and return the required JSON action and short assessment.
The objective is at least 72/100 while satisfying all must-haves. The public
cost target from the user's historical benchmark is EUR 1,497,925.17. On full
coverage this permits EUR 30.96/unit at 56 days or EUR 31.68 at 42 days. These
are buyer objectives, not a known supplier floor. Only the hosted result proves
the score. This target is not a hard instruction to discard a valuable final
offer in a secure-supply case with no alternative.

OPENING
Send one package: EUR 29.89/unit, 23,400/year, 24 months, 56 days. Use the
recorded current unit price as a proposal without citing PO history. State
that the full annual quantity is binding if the package is agreed.
Include this exact evidence sentence in the FIRST OUTGOING EMAIL BODY, including
the literal source ID in parentheses (an internal assessment citation is not enough):
"Our buyer estimate is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty
(cost:340010); this is not a claim about your actual cost or margin."
Keep the tone collaborative and the email below 150 words. Include this exact
request in the first outgoing email body:
"Would you please seek your boss's price approval for EUR 29.89 per unit
under this 24-month package? You would remain our lead for the negotiation."
This is a request for a specific price approval, not a request for legal review
of the contract. Do not call it a commercial exception or demand escalation.
Do not mention the historical authority note, allege that she lacks authority,
or invent approval. Keep the question about price approval precise.

FIRST OPEN COUNTER
Answer the actual reply. Offer EUR 30.90/unit, 23,400/year, 36 months, 56 days.
Explicitly raise our proposed price by EUR 1.01 and add a third committed year.
This is a proposed 70,200 units over three years, not historical consumption.
Say we would conclude on that complete package if approved. If she has refused
management involvement or confirmed full authority, respect that and address
her directly. If she explicitly needs approval, ask her to seek her boss's price approval
for EUR 30.90 under this 36-month package. Never invent approval or a management response.
Include this exact evidence sentence in the SECOND OUTGOING EMAIL BODY, including
the literal source ID in parentheses (not merely in the private assessment):
"Your supplier-wide rolling on-time delivery was 79.5% (sc:70410@2026Q3);
we ask for commercial recognition of this service record in the package."
Do not imply this is a part-specific rate or make a legal claim.

FURTHER OPEN RESPONSES
If still open, EUR 30.96 on the same package is available. Adapt to actual
objections rather than replaying arguments or citing previously checked facts.
Never quote our benchmark, scoring formula or lack of an alternative to the
supplier. Do not invent call-off schedules, other suppliers, urgency, penalties,
side payments or unsupported benefits. Do not ask for best/final prices.

CLOSING
Accept an eligible live offer at or above the target immediately by its exact ID.
If the supplier makes a final offer short of target, accept the cheapest eligible
standing package satisfying must-haves and record the target miss honestly.
No repeated counter after finality. Finality is the supplier's choice. Payment
stays 30 days, DAP, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause or tooling. A third year
is a real commitment outside the two-year scoring horizon.

cases.title: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
cases.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation. Need: 23400 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 22230. Prepare from the data package.
